sections.title: Overview
sections.body: The Reporting module provides cross-cutting analytical views that span multiple projects, cost centers, and time periods. All roles can access this module. Reports are **role-scoped**: controllers and executives see all data, CC owners see their cost center, and project leads see their projects.

sections.title: Report Library
sections.body: The landing page organizes reports into four sections. **Standard Reports** shows five pre-built analytical views plus the AI Report Builder tile. **Build Your Own** features the Report Builder tile for OLAP-style custom report composition. **Shared Reports** displays reports that other users have published or shared with you, showing permission badges (View only / Can edit) and the author. **My Saved Views** shows your personally saved report configurations and custom Report Builder reports (marked with a 'Custom' badge) for quick access. Click any card to open the report.

sections.title: Standard Reports
sections.body: Five standard reports are available: **Programme / Multi-Project Rollup** for consolidated financials, **Cost Center Financial Summary** for per-CC analysis, **Vendor Spend Analysis** for external cost tracking, **Forecast Accuracy** for retrospective forecast quality, and **Year-over-Year Comparison** for spending trajectory analysis.

sections.title: Report Viewer
sections.body: Each report opens in a viewer with a **filter bar** at the top, a **KPI summary row** below it, and the main content area showing either a **chart** or **table** view. Use the toggle to switch between chart and table. Filters update all sections when changed.

sections.title: Customizing Reports
sections.body: Click the **Customize** button to open a configuration panel where you can show/hide columns, change the grouping dimension, adjust sort order, and select visualization type. These customizations apply immediately to the current view.

sections.title: Exporting Data
sections.body: Click **Export** to download the current report as a CSV file. The export respects all active filters and customizations. The file includes metadata comment rows (report name, export date, active filters) followed by column headers, data rows, and a summary row.

sections.title: Saving Views
sections.body: Click **Save View** to save your current filter and customization settings as a named view. Saved views appear in the Report Library under **My Saved Views** for quick access. You can rename or delete saved views from the library.

sections.title: Report Builder (Build Your Own)
sections.body: The **Report Builder** tile opens an OLAP-style report composition tool. Use the **Data Catalog** on the left to add dimensions to **Rows**, **Columns**, or **Filters** zones, and add measures to the **Values** zone. Click **Run Report** to generate results. The builder supports **flat tables** and **cross-tabulation** (when column dimensions are set), with subtotals and grand totals.

sections.title: Calculated Measures
sections.body: Click the **fx Calculated** button in the Report Builder toolbar to create custom measures from existing ones. Define a name, choose two operand measures and an operator (+, -, x, /), and select a display format. Calculated measures appear in the Values zone with an **fx** badge and can be edited or deleted. Division by zero displays a dash. One level of nesting is supported (a calculated measure can reference another).

sections.title: Chart Views
sections.body: Use the **view toggle** (Table, Bar, Line, Pie) in the Report Builder toolbar to switch between visualizations. **Bar charts** group by the first row dimension. **Line charts** require a time dimension (Fiscal Year, Quarter, or Month) on columns. **Pie charts** show the first row dimension as segments sized by the first measure. Charts respect active filters and update when you re-run the report.

sections.title: Saving & Loading Reports
sections.body: Click **Save Report** in the Report Builder toolbar to save your current report composition. The first save prompts for a **name** and optional **description**. Subsequent saves overwrite silently. Use **Save As** (dropdown next to Save) to create a copy with a new name. Saved reports appear in the Report Library under **My Saved Views** with a **Custom** badge. Click **Load** (folder icon) to open a dropdown of your saved reports — selecting one restores all zones, filters, calculated measures, conditional formatting, and view mode, then auto-runs the query.

sections.title: Sharing & Publishing Reports
sections.body: After saving a Report Builder report, click the **Share** button to share it with other users. Select recipients, choose a permission level (**View only** or **Can edit**), and optionally toggle **Publish to Report Library** to make the report visible to all users in the **Shared Reports** section. Shared reports appear in the recipient's **Shared with Me** section in the Report Library.

sections.title: Report Builder Export
sections.body: Click **Export** in the Report Builder toolbar to download the current report as a CSV file. The export includes metadata comment rows (report name, export date, user, active filters) followed by column headers and data rows with subtotals and grand totals. Cross-tabulated reports are flattened into columns named by dimension value and measure (e.g. 'Q1 2026 - Forecast'). File naming follows the pattern CRETA_ReportBuilder_[Name]_[Date].csv.

sections.title: AI Report Builder
sections.body: The **AI Report Builder** tile in the Report Library opens a conversational interface where you can describe any report in natural language. The AI queries the database directly, generates tables, charts, and KPI cards, and lets you iteratively refine the output. An Anthropic API key must be configured in **Administration > Planning Parameters > Integrations** before use.
